summary: Genmab filed a Form 6-K disclosing a capital increase of 2,346 shares from employee warrant exercises at DKK 1,147.50, DKK 1,334.50, and DKK 1,362.50 per share. The increase represents 0.004% of share capital and raised approximately DKK 3.0 million. This is a routine employee equity plan transaction with no special-situation implications.
